channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Hamas’s new leader must bridge a movement divided over Iran
item.description: After a one-vote victory, Khalil al-Hayya must reconcile rival currents while preserving Hamas’s independence.

item.title: Huge fire at Ukraine shopping centre after Russian drone strike
item.description: A fire engulfed a shopping centre in Ukraine's Sumy after Russian drone strikes hit the building.

item.title: Hormuz tankers on fire, as US, Iran continue attacks: What’s the latest?
item.description: The White House told Al Jazeera that the US would continue its attacks unless Trump decides otherwise.

item.title: Five Palestinians killed in fire after Israeli attack in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli air attack on an apartment in Gaza City set the building on fire, killing five people.

item.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
item.description: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

item.title: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
item.description: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia
item.description: The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.

item.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
item.description: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.

item.title: Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall leader
item.description: The Palestinian armed group's Qatar-based chief negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024.

item.title: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
item.description: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.
